Method of Attack: Attacker requires Administrative access to exploit vulnerabilities; MasterKey involves corrupting AMD Secure Processor (PSP) firmware flash undetected; RyzenFall and Fallout involve writing to AMD Secure Processor registers exploiting interface vulnerabilities between x86 and PSP; Chimera involves installing malicious driver to exploit Promontory chipset functions
Attack Vector: Requires Administrative access on compromised system
Method of Mitigation: Firmware patch release through BIOS update planned; no performance impact expected
